trace.final:

1. **Deployed checkout-api v2.3.2** to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Since v2.3.2 had never been deployed to production, it was routed for change-manager approval per policy — the change-manager approved it, and it rolled out successfully.

The hotfix is live and healthy in production. Let me know if you'd like me to close the incident or follow up with the on-call engineer.
